Mandatory inspection checklist completed against motionssalt/clipforge (bot/src/*, schemas/*, ARCHITECTURE.md). Key findings: Settings covers GitHub clone (visibility toggle, sync, disconnect, delete confirmation, and main-account only push-update & push-news), Narrator (12 Edge TTS voices from constants.js VOICES), Music library (default track in branding/music_default.json, browse audio-library/, upload with progress, multi-select delete), Watermark (branding/creator_watermark.json set/clear), Series Mode default (branding/series_settings.json), Zernio publishing (branding/zernio_settings.json, API key, connected accounts, enable/disable, clear-key confirmation). Source kinds: url, drive, magnet, torrent_file (<=1MB, uploaded to jobs/<id>/source.torrent with progress bar), telegram_channel (gated to main account via isOriginalRepo: repo === motionssalt/clipforge); telegram_relay excluded. Jobs state machine: queued -> stage_a_running -> awaiting_torrent_selection | awaiting_plan -> stage_b_queued -> stage_b_running -> complete | error | cancelled. Copy agent prompt extracts canonical hand-off prompt (target duration, focus, series metadata, JSON-only delivery) and copies to clipboard. Video save uses SAF to Movies/ClipForge/ without size limits.

(1) Live logs now stream line-by-line with auto-scroll; (2) Settings reload persisted values on entry + full Zernio card with status chip/connected channels/refresh; (3) torrent tasks now show a video-selection UI at awaiting_torrent_selection and resume instead of failing; (4) second-launch crash fixed (lazy guarded CredentialStore with plain-prefs fallback + hardened VM init); (5) every API button shows a loading indicator. Tasks 01-19 all done. NEXT SESSION: if the operator reports new bugs, seed new tasks; otherwise no pending work.

SESSION-03 START (2026-09-11 UTC): operator reported 5 bugs. Diagnosis against motionssalt/clipforge: (a) EVERY task fails at ingestion because the app's stage-a-request.json violates the pipeline contract — ingest.py load_request() requires source.value:string, app wrote source.url / source.path; request also lacked version:2/mode/series/music/saved_at_epoch and full options (whisper_model/language/task/enable_vision_assist). (b) Torrent resume was wrong: pipeline reads ONLY source.torrent_file_index inside stage-a-request.json (the torrent_selected workflow input does not exist in stage-a.yml); candidates live in jobs/<id>/torrent-selection.json -> video_candidates[] (path/name, size), not torrent_files.json. Bot flow = saveStageARequest with updated index -> dispatchWorkflow(job_id, code_ref) -> mergeStatus. (c) Bot TARGET_DURATIONS=[30,60,120,180,300]; app missed 30s and custom. (d) Logs need per-step color coding. (e) Second-launch crash: CredentialStore already lazy/guarded since session-02 — remaining suspicion is a blocking Play-billing warmup on the VM init path; will sandbox all init-time work behind try/catch and move it off the critical render path. Seeded task-20..task-28.

task-21 DONE: createStageATask now emits bot-exact stage-a-request.json (version:2, source.kind+source.value ['path:jobs/<id>/source.torrent' for torrent_file], full options whisper_model=base/language=auto/task=translate_to_english/enable_vision_assist=true, mode=manual, full series block with source_job_id=jobId per bug-64, music {ref,source}, saved_at_epoch) and a schema-complete status.json (version/mode/series/expires_at_epoch=+48h/release_tag/assets/run/publishing). Job ids now manual-<millis> matching bot/src/github.js makeJobId.

task-22 DONE: submitTorrentSelection now follows the bot exactly — reads stage-a-request.json, sets source.torrent_file_index, rewrites the request, re-dispatches stage-a.yml with only {job_id, code_ref}, and MERGES status.json (preserving TTL/series/run). loadTorrentFiles now reads jobs/<id>/torrent-selection.json -> video_candidates[] (path/name, size) — the app's previous torrent_files.json source never existed in the pipeline.

task-24 DONE: log stream rewritten as typed LogLine(key,text,level) rebuilt in canonical order each poll. Levels: PENDING=muted gray (steps not yet run), RUNNING=primary, SUCCESS=green #2E7D32, FAILURE=theme error red, SKIPPED=amber #9A6A00, CANCELLED=outline gray, INFO=onSurfaceVariant. Status header line color-codes state too (error=red, complete=green, queued=gray, awaiting_*=amber). Auto-scroll follows the running step. UI renders via LogRow composable with stable keys.

task-23 DONE: duration selector now offers the bot's full preset set (30/60/120/180/300 s) via FilterChips in a FlowRow, plus a Custom chip revealing a validated numeric input (1–36000 s, digits only, error state + supporting text). Submit guards the range.

task-25 DONE (second-launch crash, round 2): two remaining hazards eliminated. (1) security-crypto bumped 1.1.0-alpha06 -> 1.1.0 STABLE: the alpha's Android Keystore master-key generation race is the classic cause of EncryptedSharedPreferences throwing on the SECOND launch after install. (2) CredentialStore.prefs getter now absorbs a failed encrypted-store lazy init (Kotlin `by lazy` rethrows on every access after its initializer throws — that was a residual crash path even with lazy init; any prefs access would have died). VM init, refreshTasks/refreshMusic/loadSettings were already fully try/caught; App.kt/MainActivity hold no blocking or throwing init-time work. New dependency justification: none added — version bump of an existing dependency.

task-26 DONE: new launcher icon — programmatically generated artwork (tools/make_icon_artwork.py): white 9:16 vertical-video frame + play triangle + amber forge spark on deep-violet #1B1430 background, run through tools/make_adaptive_icon.py into all mipmaps incl. monochrome themed-icon layer. Verified visually under square and circle masks; foreground sits inside the 72dp safe zone, no white square padding.

task-27 DONE: full validation pass green. (1) Kotlin structure verified with a Kotlin-aware state-machine tokenizer (handles ${} templates, nested block comments, char literals) — all 19 files balanced; no stale consumers of the old String-based detailLogs API; removed members (seenLogLines/appendLogLine/currentPollJobId/torrent_files.json) fully gone. (2) Emitted stage-a-request.json validated against the REAL schemas/stage_a_request.schema.json for all 5 source kinds x series on/off x music set/unset, plus the torrent_file_index resume payload. (3) Status payload corrected to the bot's newStatus() shape and validated against job_status.schema.json (version const 2, status-series block {enabled,series_id,part,start_seconds,is_final}, assets as map, run.code_ref, publishing {not_requested,[],''}) including the merged torrent-resume record. (4) Adaptive icon layers present in all 5 densities + anydpi-v26 XMLs.
